payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped reusable @Observable FrickSessionManager (Sources/FrickSwift/SwiftUI/FrickSessionManager.swift): session/isAuthenticated/isAuthenticating + signIn/signUp/signOut/requestPasswordReset/resetPassword delegating to FrickClient. Owns no persistence — rides FrickClient's existing Keychain auto-persist/restore; mirrors client.currentSession into the observable session. 9 new tests (FrickSessionManagerTests) green; full swift test 71/71 pass; pnpm typecheck exit 0. RangerCRM can now delete its UserDefaults session persistence and observe this holder.
